bug: user_bytes double-counted 2x on the std/sim wrapper paths
found_by: throughput/energy measurement track, 2026-07-29; verified independently by orchestrator
root_cause: Slate::append_hot counts (REC_OVERHEAD+klen+vlen) in slate-kv-core/src/slate.rs:244 so no_std targets measure WA too; five wrapper call sites counted the same record again (slate-kv/src/db.rs put + 2 delete paths, slate-kv-sim/src/sim_db.rs put + 2 delete paths).
affected: every WA figure derived from the std or sim path, including the pre-fix docs/porposal/data/wa_buckets.csv
not_affected: the ESP32-C3 device log: the firmware calls append_hot directly and never goes through a wrapper, so its user_bytes (74 B/record) and WA (2.7435) were always single-counted
fix: removed the five duplicate add_user_bytes calls; one call site remains, in the core append path
